items.html: And when the mochin of Chaya enter, which is the Bina of Aba, which are fit to procreate, they can, even when they couple below in their place, return face to face, as is known. Then he gives her, in a complete coupling, a drop of Hasadim of AB of Yudin, which is true AB. For she has already taken the Gevurot of AB by means of ZA and Ima face to face, but not in a complete coupling. But now he gives her, in a complete coupling, the Hasadim of AB; and these are true Neshama. And this is called a complete coupling.
